description_en: Creates an Object Storage Service (OSS) file upload task
description_zh: 调用CreateUploadOSSFileJob接口，创建上传OSS附件任务
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise create-upload-oss-file-job --file-source datacorrect --file-name test.sql --upload-target BucketName=test_bucket Endpoint=http://oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com ObjectName=test.sql --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateUploadOSSFileJob

parameters.help_en:
The purpose of uploading the attachment. Valid values:
datacorrect: data change ticket
order_info_attachment: ticket attachment
big-file: batch data import
sqlreview: SQL review
parameters.help_zh:
上传附件的使用目的，取值和说明如下：
datacorrect：数据变更工单
order_info_attachment：工单附件
big-file：批量数据导入
sqlreview：SQL审核
parameters.name: file_source

parameters.help_en:
The file name.
The file name must end with .txt or .sql, such as test.txt
parameters.help_zh:
文件名。
需要以txt、sql结尾，例如test.txt
parameters.name: file_name

fields.help_en: The unique identifier of the OSS bucket
fields.name: bucket_name

fields.help_en: The name of the OSS object
fields.name: object_name

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.
You can obtain the tenant ID by moving the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

JobKey.description_en: The key of the attachment upload task. You can use the key to query the upload progress and task details. For more information, see [GetUserUploadFileJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html）
JobKey.description_zh: 上传附件任务Key，可查询附件上传进展与任务详情，详情请参见[GetUserUploadFileJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html）

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
